name: listing.draftId
title: Field: listing.draftId
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.draftId field.
text:
# listing.draftId

TL;DR:
- listing.draftId points back to the source draft when that relation is available.

What it means:
- A listing is published from a draft.
- draftId is the linkage to that source draft when the relation is exposed in the current surface.
- Null means the source draft relation is not available in the current output.

Agent hint:
- Use this as provenance metadata, not as a buyer-editing affordance.
